theory.title: Exercise 2.1.1: The Settings Section
theory.content:
📋 The Suite Control Panel

MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, every test suite needs configuration. The *** Settings *** section is like your ship's control panel - it sets up everything before tests run."

"Documentation tells other robots what this suite does. It's the first thing they'll read when examining your diagnostic files."

🔧 What is the Settings Section?

The *** Settings *** section is a required section header that appears at the top of every Robot Framework file. It contains suite-level configuration:

  • Documentation - Describes what the suite does
  • Library imports - Load external functionality
  • Suite Setup/Teardown - Run before/after all tests
  • Test Setup/Teardown - Run before/after each test
  • Default Tags - Auto-tag all tests
  • Test Timeout - Set max execution time

📝 Basic Settings Structure

*** Settings ***
Documentation    This suite tests the login functionality

*** Test Cases ***
My Test
    Log    Test running

Key Rules:

  • ✅ Settings section header at left margin (no indentation)
  • ✅ Setting names (Documentation) indented with at least 2 spaces
  • ✅ Values separated by 4 spaces (or 2+ tabs)
  • ✅ Settings section comes BEFORE Test Cases

⚙️ Settings Section Rules

  • 🔹 Position: Always first section in the file
  • 🔹 Header: *** Settings *** (3 asterisks before and after)
  • 🔹 Indentation: Settings are indented, header is not
  • 🔹 Spacing: 4 spaces between setting name and value
  • 🔹 Optional: Can be empty, but header must exist if you have settings

🎯 Your Task

Create a Settings section with Documentation, then add a test case below it. This establishes the proper file structure for all future test suites.
